title: Step 4: CNN Training - Epochs, Loss Function & Metrics in TensorFlow

cues.en: -: Hello, my friends.
cues.zh: 朋友們好。

cues.en: Welcome back to this implementation and mostly welcome to part three, training the CNN.
cues.zh: 歡迎回到實作，尤其歡迎進入第三部分，訓練 CNN。

cues.en: In the previous tutorial, we built the brain, which contained the eyes of the AI, you know thanks to the convolutional layers, and now we're gonna make that brain smart
cues.zh: 上一堂課建立了這個大腦，透過卷積層，讓 AI 擁有眼睛；現在要讓這個大腦變聰明，

cues.en: with that training of the CNN on all our training set images.
cues.zh: 用訓練集裡的所有影像訓練 CNN。

cues.en: And at the same time, as you see, we're gonna evaluate our same model on the test set over the epochs, you know, we're gonna train our CNN over 25 epochs,
cues.zh: 同時，如你所見，每個訓練週期都會在測試集評估模型。CNN 會訓練 25 個週期，

cues.en: and at each epoch we will actually see how our model is performing on our test set images.
cues.zh: 每個週期都能看到模型在測試影像上的表現。

cues.en: So this is a different kind of training as what we did before because we always used to separate the training and the evaluation, but here this will happen at the same time.
cues.zh: 這與先前的訓練稍有不同，因為之前總將訓練與評估分開，這裡則同時進行。

cues.en: That's because we're doing some specific application, which is computer vision.
cues.zh: 因為這裡處理的是電腦視覺這種特定應用。

cues.en: All right, are you ready?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's start with the first step, compiling the CNN.
cues.zh: 先做第一步，編譯 CNN。

cues.en: All right, so in a new code cell, we're gonna compile the CNN, meaning we're gonna connect it to an optimizer, a loss function, and some metrics.
cues.zh: 在新儲存格裡編譯 CNN，也就是連接最佳化器、損失函數與評估指標。

cues.en: And well, you know, here once again we're doing binary classification.
cues.zh: 這裡同樣做二元分類。

cues.en: And so, very simply, we're gonna compile our CNN exactly the same way as how we compiled our ANN in the previous section.
cues.zh: 所以很簡單，採用和上一節編譯 ANN 完全相同的方式。

cues.en: Because indeed, we're gonna choose once again an atom optimizer to you know, perform stochastic gradient descent, to update the weight in order to reduce the loss error
cues.zh: 再次選用 Adam 最佳化器，進行隨機梯度下降，更新權重，以減少預測值

cues.en: between the predictions and the target.
cues.zh: 與目標值之間的損失誤差。

cues.en: Then we're gonna choose the same loss, you know the binary cross entropy loss.
cues.zh: 接著選擇相同的損失，也就是二元交叉熵。

cues.en: Once again, because we're doing exactly the same task, binary classification.
cues.zh: 同樣因為任務完全相同，都是二元分類。

cues.en: And then same for the metrics, we're gonna choose the accuracy metrics, because that's, you know, the most relevant way to measure the performance of a classification model.
cues.zh: 評估指標也一樣，選準確率，因為這裡以它衡量分類模型效能最合適，

cues.en: which is exactly the case with our CNN.
cues.zh: 而 CNN 正是分類模型。

cues.en: And therefore, to compile the CNN, well, it's gonna be a piece of cake, because indeed we're gonna do exactly the same as before.
cues.zh: 因此編譯 CNN 非常簡單，和之前完全相同。

cues.en: So we're gonna start by taking our CNN, from which we're gonna call the compile method, which will take as input,
cues.zh: 先使用 cnn，呼叫 compile 方法，它需要的輸入，

cues.en: well, first our optimizer, which we'll choose to be the atom optimizer.
cues.zh: 首先是 optimizer，選擇 Adam。

cues.en: Then the loss function, which we'll choose to be the binary cross entropy.
cues.zh: 再來是 loss，選擇 binary_crossentropy。

cues.en: All right, and finally, final argument, the metrics, we will choose only one, but remember we have the choice to take several of them, but just the accuracy is fine and therefore,
cues.zh: 最後一個參數 metrics，只選一項。記得也可以選多項，但這裡只有準確率就很好，因此

cues.en: in these pair of square brackets, we're gonna input in quotes, well, that accuracy.
cues.zh: 在這對中括號中，輸入引號包住的 accuracy。

cues.en: And done.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: This compiles, successfully, the CNN to the optimizer, the loss function, and the metric.
cues.zh: 這樣就成功將 CNN 與最佳化器、損失函數及指標一起編譯。

cues.en: So exactly the same as before.
cues.zh: 和之前完全相同。

cues.en: However, now to train the CNN on the training set, and evaluating it at the same time on the test set, while it will not be exactly the same as before
cues.zh: 不過，現在要在訓練集上訓練 CNN，同時在測試集評估，做法不完全和先前相同，

cues.en: but once again, very, very similar.
cues.zh: 但仍然非常類似。

cues.en: Let's check the cell, let's create a new code cell.
cues.zh: 來看看，新增程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: And now you can actually guess the first two steps, they're always the same.
cues.zh: 你應該猜得到前兩步，總是相同。

cues.en: The first step is to take, of course, our CNN, from which, and that's the second step, what method do we need to call here?
cues.zh: 第一步當然先使用 cnn；第二步，你覺得要呼叫什麼方法？

cues.en: Well, once again, this never changes, this is of course the fit method.
cues.zh: 同樣從未改變，當然是 fit 方法。

cues.en: The fit method, which as always will train the CNN on the training set.
cues.zh: fit 和往常一樣，會在訓練集上訓練 CNN。

cues.en: Okay, so this time what are gonna be the input?
cues.zh: 好，這次的輸入是什麼？

cues.en: Well, the first input is always the same.
cues.zh: 第一個輸入總是一樣。

cues.en: It's going to be, of course the set, you know, the data set on which you're gonna train your model here at the CNN, and that's of course the training set.
cues.zh: 當然是用來訓練模型的資料集，這裡是 CNN，所以就是訓練集。

cues.en: And the name of the parameter for that is simply "X", and therefore we'll specify "X" to be, you know, our training set,
cues.zh: 參數名稱是 x，因此指定 x 為 training_set，

cues.en: that exact same training set which we created in part one, you know, right here, that training set, that training set to which we applied this
cues.zh: 也就是第一部分建立的這個訓練集，就在這裡。這個訓練集已使用

cues.en: image data generated tool, to indeed perform image augmentation.
cues.zh: ImageDataGenerator 工具，進行影像增強。

cues.en: All right, so that training set, that's the first input of our parameter in this fit method.
cues.zh: 好，training_set 就是 fit 方法的第一個輸入參數。

cues.en: Okay, then next parameter.
cues.zh: 接著是下一個參數。

cues.en: All right, so the next parameter is this time, you know the difference, the difference with what we did before.
cues.zh: 下一個參數就是這次和之前不同的地方。

cues.en: So it has to do, of course, with the fact that we are not only training the CNN on the training set, but also evaluating it at the same time on the test set.
cues.zh: 當然和我們不只訓練 CNN，也同時在測試集上評估它有關。

cues.en: And that second parameter corresponds exactly to this, we have to specify here the validation data.
cues.zh: 第二個參數正是對應這件事，必須在這裡指定 validation_data。

cues.en: That's the name of the parameter, but that's of course the set on which we want to evaluate our CNN.
cues.zh: 這是參數名稱，代表要用來評估 CNN 的資料集。

cues.en: And that's of course the test set, that will be the value of the parameter.
cues.zh: 當然是 test_set，它就是參數值。

cues.en: But the name of that parameter is, as I just said, "validation_data",
cues.zh: 但參數名稱如剛才所說，是 validation_data，

cues.en: and this is equal of course, to the test set.
cues.zh: 它當然等於 test_set。

cues.en: Once again, that exact same test set which we created here in part one when pre-processing a test set, this one to which of course, no transformation was applied,
cues.zh: 再次提醒，就是第一部分前處理測試集時建立的這一個，沒有套用影像增強轉換，

cues.en: only feature scaling.
cues.zh: 只有特徵縮放。

cues.en: Okay, so test set, good.
cues.zh: 好，test_set，完成。

cues.en: And now we have one final argument, which is of course, you can totally guess what it is, right?
cues.zh: 現在還有最後一個參數，你應該完全猜得到是什麼，對吧？

cues.en: This is the inevitable argument when training a deep neural network.
cues.zh: 訓練深度神經網路時，少不了這個參數。

cues.en: I'm talking of course about the epochs parameter, which is a number of epochs.
cues.zh: 當然就是 epochs，也就是訓練週期數。

cues.en: And well, you know, to justify to you which number I chose, well, I actually started with 10 epochs, and I noticed that the accuracy was not converging,
cues.zh: 說明一下我為何選這個數字：一開始試 10 個週期，發現準確率還沒收斂，

cues.en: so then I tried with 15 epochs, because you're gonna see that one epoch is actually pretty slow, you know it's actually a bit long, I mean much longer than the epochs in the training of our previous neural network,
cues.zh: 接著試 15 個。因為你會看到，每個週期其實有點慢，比先前神經網路訓練的每個週期久得多，

cues.en: you know, the ANN.
cues.zh: 也就是先前 ANN。

cues.en: So I started with 10, it was not enough, then 15, still not enough, you know, still not converging.
cues.zh: 一開始 10 個不夠，15 個仍不夠，還沒收斂。

cues.en: And then 25, and 25 was perfect.
cues.zh: 後來試 25 個，就剛剛好。

cues.en: I had an accuracy that pretty much converged.
cues.zh: 準確率差不多收斂了。

cues.en: not only on the training set, but also on the test set, you'll see.
cues.zh: 不只訓練集，測試集也是，等等就會看到。

cues.en: So for the number of epochs here, we're gonna choose 25.
cues.zh: 所以這裡 epochs 選擇 25。

cues.en: Feel free to increase it if you have time, you know, if you want to let your computer run for an hour or more with 25 epochs here it'll be fine, it will just take 10 to 15 minutes,
cues.zh: 有時間可以再增加，讓電腦跑一小時以上也可以。這裡 25 個週期，大約只要 10 到 15 分鐘，

cues.en: so that will be all good.
cues.zh: 所以沒問題。

cues.en: We'll get our results pretty fast.
cues.zh: 很快就會得到結果。

cues.en: All right, and well, actually, that's it.
cues.zh: 其實這樣就完成了。

cues.en: That's only what we need to train our CNN on the training set while evaluating it on the test set.
cues.zh: 在訓練集上訓練 CNN、同時在測試集上評估，只需要這些。

cues.en: So, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: We smashed part three, and we can now already move on to part four, where we're gonna make our single prediction, which I remind will consist of
cues.zh: 第三部分完成，現在可以進入第四部分，做單筆預測。提醒一下，這是要

cues.en: deploying our model on the two images of the single prediction folder.
cues.zh: 將模型套用到 single_prediction 資料夾的兩張影像。

cues.en: This one for which of course, our model will have to recognize that there is a dog, and this one where our model will have to recognize that there is a cat.
cues.zh: 這一張，模型當然應辨識出狗；這一張，模型應辨識出貓。

cues.en: So let's hope that it is right, but we won't have the predictions in next tutorial, we will have them in the one after that.
cues.zh: 希望它能答對，但下一堂還不會得到預測，要再下一堂才會。

cues.en: Because remember, we're gonna run our implementation from Jupyter Notebook, because we come it in Google CoLab, the data set is too big.
cues.zh: 因為記得，我們會使用 Jupyter Notebook 執行實作，在這個示範中，資料集太大而不在 Google Colab 執行。

cues.en: All right, so well, as soon as you're ready for part four, let's do this together.
cues.zh: 準備好第四部分後，就一起做吧。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
